doc_summary: `native_mouse_scrolling(scroll, accumulated, buttons, cursor, modifiers, canceled)` fires with a player in gameplay and no open screen/prompt/sleeping UI, once at least one whole scroll step accumulates and before hotbar/spectator handling. scroll is x/y after discrete/sensitivity scaling (touchpad pixels normalized by 30), accumulated is the whole x/y pair, buttons are physical left/middle/right, cursor is the GUI position, and modifiers use GLFW bits. Cancel skips gameplay scrolling; accumulated whole steps remain consumed. Synthetic input skips the new hook. The legacy vertical native_wheel still runs first and can consume the event; screen-scroll hooks are unchanged. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mouse_scrolling@.
